October 9, 2026


# ChatGPT and Codex: install Bird from the plugin directory


Bird is now in the[ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6ac74d2aa37481918759cbb0ea8aa6c6) andCodex plugin directories. Install it, sign in to your Bird workspace, and your agent can send email, SMS and WhatsApp, manage domains and numbers, and check delivery.


Try a task:


- "Set up acme.com as a sending domain and tell me which DNS records to add."
- "Send a test email and check whether it was delivered."
- "Why are emails to Outlook bouncing?"
- "Draft replies to everything unanswered in my support inbox."
- "Audit acme.com’s email authentication."
